html:
Gold Seller Leads Atlanta

CaratBase connects independent jewelers in Atlanta with local gold sellers, appraisal seekers, and engagement ring buyers. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

What you get

  • First 3 leads free
  • $40 per accepted lead
  • Optional Pro website widget, $12/month

Why CaratBase

CaratBase is starting in Atlanta, so leads are local to the Atlanta metro area.

FAQ

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

Can I cancel the Pro widget? Yes. The Pro widget can be cancelled whenever, and it drops back to the free version.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
